scope: Final RC8 source UI. Every required screenshot viewed by implementer AI; self-review is not independent. Original screenshots and trace retained in the temporary capture packet.

packet.machineScope: Real source Electron main/preload/renderer and durable input; scripted cognition only; not installed or real-model timing

quickChatBots.scope: Actual window and durable Bot profile IPC; native popup callbacks controlled, scripted model only

taskDetails.scope: Production renderer and IPC with isolated session and main-conversation fixtures; no real model or task approval

modelSwitch.scope: Production menu, renderer and durable profile through actual IPC; 650ms controlled save, no model network

messageLayout.scope: Production system-card rendering from isolated canonical conversation data, including long JSON, URL and unbroken ID; no provider network

workSurfaces: collapsed background summary exposes named running work before any expansion
background task and composer share both edges when collapsed and expanded at 1600/1280/760px in both themes
keyboard work disclosure uses a thin inset focus indicator, without the clipped white frame
named running work scans visibly and expands by keyboard to its actual progress
waiting work stays a factual status in reply and background; named main bot owns follow-up, optional detail returns to main dialogue
main-side notifications update running to waiting, accepted and unavailable; old reply snapshots never revive running
evidence has its own detail view; returning shows bot identity and responsibility, with no execution log
memory starts with saved content, keeps settings and provenance on demand and contains no process view
memory filter controls fit their columns with visible spacing at 1280px and 760px in both themes
reply detail sidebar isolates process from bot profile; the Archive entry opens bot overview
classified reply and delegated work fit a 760px viewport in both themes
chatDetails: exact current-turn process uses localized operations; raw JSON is collapsed and keyboard accessible
freeform reply durably binds to its question and removes only those choices
failed freeform send retains choices; retry retains exact answer association and creates one canonical input
option click follows the same durable answer path; switching back does not restore answered choices

composerLayout.scope: Production composer, real draft and attachment admission in an isolated source Electron; no model message or permission change

accessibility: focusable list: Home/End, arrows, Enter open the selected bot
Space opens the selected bot without scrolling the page
compact conversation header labels Bot settings and enters configuration directly
bot models and declared reasoning strength save and survive reopen; cascading switch and inherit preserve other roles, bots and global routing
settings groups, keyboard disclosures, visible switches, policy/local-model/global-concurrency persistence and sticky tabs
docked drawer enters selected tab, roves with arrows/endpoints, closes with focus returned; hidden dock is inert
900px emulated viewport modal drawer constrains Tab in both directions, Escape returns focus
oversize input is rejected before submission and the editable draft is retained
10000 memory records render 50 at a time; next and previous retain distinct identities
reduced motion stops avatar/enter displacement animations while drawer remains usable
actual list name/preview/time contrast reaches 4.5:1 in both light/dark and Frost/Catppuccin
custom quiet switch and HH:mm field use keyboard, save canonical values and expose independent labels
returning to General reads saved quiet hours instead of the initial bootstrap snapshot
English settings/drawer/Quick Chat labels refresh from persisted locale; bot picker is custom

fallbackVision.scope: Production settings renderer/persistence; disposable models, no provider requests.

selectionQuote.scope: Production long Markdown reply and question card; real browser Range and selectionchange; no model call or user acceptance

reviewCriteria: 默认内容能回答任务目标、当前进展和下一步；动作写明去向，主机器人负责对用户传达。
内部 ID、模型机制和原始参数按需披露；状态来自结构化事实，目标与完成结论不得混淆。
排版有清晰层级；说明小而轻；无裁切、溢出、过宽导航按钮、重复空字段或字符图标。
对照自动交互证据检查键盘、展开收起、状态过渡和失败恢复；单张截图不能证明动画或性能。
limits: Scripted model cognition; no real provider quality or network timing
Source Electron; not an installed RC
No full screen-reader or long-duration acceptance
